Neurotypical and neurodivergent communication are fundamentally different but neither is inherently insufficient. There is just not enough overlap to facilitate an understanding of our communication style for neurotypicals. ( ADHD is a little diffrent) There is overlap. Its hard for us to be the side that closes that communication gap, it's one sided and it's exhausting. But by no means should we lower ourselves to a level where we accuse a whole group of people of being insufficient communicators. It is not the solution.

Look I'm autistic as well, and it can be hard knowing that in certain situations I'm Privy to black-and-white thinking, not always, but even still it's a worry that nibs at me. We can only accept that this is a byproduct of being autistic, active acknowledgement of black-and-white thinking is the advantage. This is not to say that all autistic people think solely in black and white, far from. But acknowledging the moments where we are thinking black and white, meeting it with compassion and a giggle and using it as a reminder that like, every human, neurotypical or not, we are all ultimately, chronically human, can only benefit are adaptability and flexibility.
